# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use this repository's **Security** tab and its private vulnerability reporting form. Do not open a public issue
for a suspected vulnerability.

Include the affected source path, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation. Do not include SDK keys from a
live app, Orders API keys, App Store Connect keys, personal data, or production company data. SideShift will acknowledge
the report and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available.

For account, billing, or product support that is not a software vulnerability, use
[SideShift Contact](https://sideshift.app/contact).

## Supported versions

The latest tagged release is supported. Security fixes are released as a new version.
